paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
This line chart illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—for the Llama3-8B model when applied to songs. The horizontal axis, labeled “Question Popularity,” ranges from 5 to 25, with evenly spaced integer tick marks. The vertical axis, labeled “Values,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The chart displays three distinct lines, each marked with a different color and symbol, as indicated in the legend: Accuracy (blue line with circular markers), Confidence (green line with triangular markers), and Alignment (reddish-pink line with square markers).

The Accuracy line (blue) begins at approximately 0.15 when Question Popularity is 5 and increases to a peak of about 0.52 at Question Popularity 10. It then decreases slightly to around 0.40 at Question Popularity 15, before rising steadily to approximately 0.62 at Question Popularity 25. The Confidence line (green) starts at about 0.70 at Question Popularity 5 and generally trends upward, reaching a peak of approximately 0.87 near Question Popularity 10, followed by a slight decline to about 0.79 near Question Popularity 15, and then continues its upward trend to approximately 0.93 at Question Popularity 25. The Alignment line (reddish-pink) begins at about 0.45 at Question Popularity 5, rises to a peak of approximately 0.70 near Question Popularity 17, and then gradually declines to approximately 0.67 at Question Popularity 25.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the QA performance, confidence, and alignment of the Llama3-8B model across varying levels of question popularity. The x-axis, labeled “Question Popularity,” spans from 5 to 25 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, representing the popularity metric without specified units. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, indicating normalized performance metrics. The blue line with circular markers represents “Accuracy,” starting at approximately 0.15 at Question Popularity 5, rising to about 0.50 at 10, declining to roughly 0.40 at 15, and then increasing to approximately 0.62 at 25. The green line with triangular markers represents “Confidence,” beginning at around 0.70 at 5, peaking near 0.85 at 10, and steadily increasing to approximately 0.93 at 25. The red line with square markers represents “Alignment,” starting at about 0.45 at 5, rising to approximately 0.62 at 10, remaining relatively flat around 0.62 until 17, then slightly decreasing to about 0.66 at 25.
